summary: This bill expands the advanced manufacturing production tax credit to include additional critical minerals like boron, copper, and uranium, allows for the inclusion of ore extraction costs for these minerals under certain conditions, and removes the reduced credit amount for metallurgical coal.

scores.thoughts: This bill expands and improves an existing advanced manufacturing production tax credit by including more critical minerals and allowing extraction costs to be included. This effectively lowers the tax burden for companies involved in critical mineral production, thus reducing tax revenue.

The bill expands the Section 45X advanced manufacturing production tax credit by adding numerous critical minerals, allowing extraction costs to qualify, and repealing the reduced credit rate for metallurgical coal. These changes constitute new tax expenditures with no offsetting revenue provisions, directly increasing the federal deficit to subsidize domestic mineral production.
